answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 48987 Country: India Title: Yusuf or Mohammad Yusuf Question: Please advise if both are correct names or which is correct and better name as per sharia: YUSUF or MOHAMMAD YUSUF Answer ID: 48987 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1663/1329/B=12/1434) Both the names are alright, but Muhammad or Ahmad add beauty to a name; therefore it is better to choose Muhammad Yusuf. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
